subject: english
question: One major advantages of the complete lockdown for animals was more _______.
solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is **free space**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the passage we find **"****During the lockdown phase, animals had an increased and uninterrupted territory. In some areas, wild animals were seen on roads and in residential areas. Less traffic, less human intervention and less pollution gave space to wildlife to thrive."**
 
• The above statement states that **free space** should be the appropriate answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• If we use** traffic** in the sentence then it will be - One major advantage of the complete lockdown for animals was more traffic, which does not make any sense.
 
• If we use **pollution** in the sentence then it will be - One major advantage of the complete lockdown for animals was more pollution, which does not make any sense.
 
• If we use **human control** in the sentence then it will be - One major advantage of the complete lockdown for animals was more human control, which does not make any sense.

 

Hence, the correct sentence is **One major advantage of the complete lockdown for animals was more free space.**
